selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: What does the traveler decide to do in order to gain a higher level of faith?
questions.answer: He decides to look at the universe as a whole and learn from what it points to.

questions.question: What does the traveler expect to gain by studying the cosmos?
questions.answer: He expects stronger, clearer, and more complete faith.

questions.question: Why is it important that his way of looking comes from the Qur’an?
questions.answer: It means his reading of the universe is guided by revelation rather than by confusion or guesswork.

questions.question: Besides a book, what other two images are used for the cosmos?
questions.answer: It is also pictured as a decorated palace and an organized city.

questions.question: What is the effect of mentioning everything from large sections down to single letters?
questions.answer: It shows that meaning and order exist at every level of the universe.

questions.question: What does the passage conclude from the universe’s meaningful patterns?
questions.answer: That there is one Creator with total knowledge and total power.

questions.question: Which groups within the cosmos are said to give witness together?
questions.answer: Its species, particles, inhabitants, contents, and all that comes into it and goes out of it all give witness together.

questions.question: What is the significance of species and particles both giving testimony?
questions.answer: It means both the large patterns and the smallest details point to the same truth.

questions.question: What kind of Maker is described by the passage’s second paragraph?
questions.answer: A unique and exalted Maker who acts with unlimited power and endless wisdom.

questions.question: What is the main goal of the traveler at the start of this passage?
questions.answer: He wants to rise to another degree of faith.

questions.question: What method does he choose for advancing in faith?
questions.answer: He chooses to reflect on the entire universe and learn from its testimony.

questions.question: How does the passage connect the parts of the cosmos with the whole cosmos?
questions.answer: It says the whole can further explain and enrich the lessons learned from the parts.

questions.question: What does the image of an orderly city add to the meaning of the passage?
questions.answer: It emphasizes arrangement, coordination, and purposeful governance.

questions.question: What do the changing forms in the universe still maintain despite their constant shifts?
questions.answer: They still maintain meaning, harmony, and a unified message.

questions.question: What do the universe’s ongoing changes say about the one behind it?
questions.answer: They say that the one behind it actively governs it with knowledge and power.

questions.question: Which parts of the universe are included in the second line of testimony after the book image?
questions.answer: All kinds of beings, tiny particles, residents of the cosmos, what fills it, and what enters and leaves it.

questions.question: What can be inferred from the phrase about wise renewal in the cosmos?
questions.answer: Renewal happens with purpose and planning, not through blind repetition.

questions.question: What two divine qualities are most emphasized by the witness of the cosmos?
questions.answer: Power without limit and wisdom without end.

questions.question: In this passage, what step does the traveler take next on his journey of belief?
questions.answer: He turns from individual things to the whole universe for further guidance.

questions.question: What does he believe the cosmos can do for the lessons he has already received?
questions.answer: It can complete them and make them brighter.

questions.question: How is the cosmos described in relation to a book?
questions.answer: It is presented as if it were a living book full of meaning, order, and signs.

questions.question: How is the cosmos like a mercifully governed city?
questions.answer: It appears organized, sustained, and run with care and order.

questions.question: Why does the passage stress both stability of order and movement of change?
questions.answer: To show that even change itself follows a controlled and meaningful pattern.

questions.question: What does the passage imply about the maker’s knowledge by saying He sees all things in all things?
questions.answer: It implies complete awareness of every being and how each thing is connected to the rest.
